reasons: Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was raised — appropriate for an internal evidence finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: p0004 structures the engagement 'on a task by task basis' via individually agreed SOWs, and p0013 is time-and-materials per SOW with no minimum volume, requirements commitment, or penalty for using other suppliers.

The only 'exclusive' hits are benign or beneficial to us — Contractor's retained IP and a non-exclusive license granted to Company (p0021) — matching the rule's guidance that exclusivity favoring Customer is not a deviation.

Deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passes, corroborating the compliance call; the rationale correctly declines to double-flag the non-solicitation clause under this rule.
